core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hamda is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Praise, thanksgiving”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hamda corresponds to the Arabic form حمد (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); حَمْد (Ḥamd)). Its core sense is praise, thanksgiving, gratitude. Hamda is Arabic حَمْد (Ḥamd) 'praise, thanksgiving' used as a feminine personal name, from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d). The source gloss 'giving, gift' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Recorded at medium confidence because the form is identical to the masculine hamd and the feminine attribution rests on documented naming usage rather than on the form itself.
